leaf_profile_reason: capsule-anchor logs SHA256(0x00||SHA256(statement)); its source calls this a deliberate exception to its own leaf rule. RFC 9162 §2.1 defines the leaf over the ENTRY and RFC 9943 does not say whether the entry is the statement's octets or a digest of them, so this cannot be inferred from the receipt and is recorded in the pin.
